note: Explicit port-lite terrain approximations. Every plan is verified against its declared simplified specification; none is runtime-enabled.

entries.note: port-lite unlit diffuse baseline; original terrain lighting/detail is explicitly dropped

approximation.dropped_policy: keep DiffuseSampler only; drop all other samplers and lighting
approximation.reason: single-pass PICA port-lite baseline; no baked atlas or live weight table
approximation.expected_visual: flat unlit albedo; loses normal lighting, parallax, shadows
approximation.error_basis: conservative [0,1] colour bound; no per-cell weight histogram exists

material_contract.binding_observation: static_only; no live draw binding was observed

symbolic_verify.model: PICA LDR clamp; all leaves/weights and mix intermediates are in [0,1]

entries.note: port-lite near-three quantized equal diffuse mix; original weights/lighting are replaced

approximation.dropped_policy: keep diffuse0..2; replace guest weights with quantized equal mix
approximation.error_basis: weight deviation is exact for convex [0,1] colours; original-error bound is conservative because three layers and lighting are dropped
approximation.reason: three PICA texture units; guest per-cell weights are not available offline
approximation.expected_visual: smooth equal-ish three-layer albedo; loses layer dominance, normals and LOD detail

material_contract.binding_observation: static_only; no live draw binding was observed

symbolic_verify.model: PICA LDR clamp; all leaves/weights and mix intermediates are in [0,1]
